message: Supervised regression training aborted: Insufficient completed repair ground truth.

audit.decision_rationale: Completed repair count with empirical cost and duration ground truth is N=0. Minimum statistical requirement is N>=50. Training Linear Regression, Random Forest, or Gradient Boosting on parametric formula outputs or synthetic data would produce circular self-prediction without empirical operational validity.
audit.prohibition_policy: CivicPulse AI strictly prohibits reporting MAE, RMSE, or R2 metrics without genuine held-out completed municipal expenditures.

recommended_action: Continue utilizing transparent regional parametric cost and duration estimation formulas until field maintenance crews log at least 50 completed work orders with verified actual expenditures.
